description: This Java class 'ProtoMqttAdaptor' implements MQTT transport adaptation for Thingsboard, converting MQTT messages to various protocol buffer messages and vice versa, specifically handling telemetry, attributes, device claims, RPCs, provisioning, and gateway communication.

classes.name: ProtoMqttAdaptor
classes.description: A Java class implementing MQTT transport adaptation for Thingsboard, converting MQTT messages to protocol buffer messages and vice versa.

methods.name: convertToPostTelemetry
methods.description: Converts MQTT publish message to PostTelemetry protocol buffer message.

methods.name: convertToPostAttributes
methods.description: Converts MQTT publish message to PostAttribute protocol buffer message.

methods.name: convertToClaimDevice
methods.description: Converts MQTT publish message to ClaimDevice protocol buffer message.

methods.name: convertToGetAttributes
methods.description: Converts MQTT publish message to GetAttributeRequest protocol buffer message.

methods.name: convertToDeviceRpcResponse
methods.description: Converts MQTT publish message to ToDeviceRpcResponse protocol buffer message.

methods.name: convertToServerRpcRequest
methods.description: Converts MQTT publish message to ToServerRpcRequest protocol buffer message.

methods.name: convertToProvisionRequestMsg
methods.description: Converts MQTT publish message to ProvisionDeviceRequest protocol buffer message.

methods.name: convertToPublish
methods.description: Creates MQTT publish message from response or request objects.

methods.name: convertToGatewayDeviceDisconnectPublish
methods.description: Creates MQTT message for gateway device disconnect.

methods.name: convertToGatewayPublish
methods.description: Creates MQTT message for gateway attribute response, notification, or RPC request.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Extracts request ID from topic name.
